syn: genl[ OPTIONS ] OBJECT ⏎ genl { -V[ersion] | -h[elp] } ⏎ OPTIONS := { -s[tatistics] | -d[etails] | -j[son] | -p[retty] } ⏎ OBJECT := { ctrl CTRL_OPTS } ⏎ CTRL_OPTS := { help | list | monitor | get PARMS } ⏎ PARMS := { name NAME | id ID }

o.en: Output results in JavaScript Object Notation (JSON).
